1) AA DNA adduct levels are significantly higher in patients with EN than in controls; 2) AA DNA addducts are not detected in the blood of patients with EN; 3) AA DNA addunct levels correlate with the severity of tubulointersticial fibrosis and urothelial tumors; and 4) AA DNA adduc levels are higher in patients with upper urotheial tumors and lower in patients with lower urothelial tumours,

the role of AA in the pathogenesis of EN.

the consumption of AA in herbal tea is not the main factor in the development of EN.

herbal teas are not a factor in endemic (Balkan nephropathy) and that it is not a factor in other forms of AAN.
